title: FNM // FRACTAL NAVIGATION MAP Modular Seed for v5.0 Development
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A noncanonical alpha accumulator by Lee Sharks used to construct the Fractal Navigation Map v5.0.

The seed integrates the January 19 *Paper Roses* cluster and the January 20 Logotic Foundation cluster into a modular architecture of rooms, chambers, institutions, creators, protocols, and cross-anchors. Its header identifies it as `FNM-SEED-5.0-alpha`, a working document and accumulator “not for DOI.” The seed preserves the developmental state immediately before the crystallized v5.0 map at #364, including provisional counts, planned nodes, and relations later revised or superseded.
reading: Force → Foundation → Proof → Proof → Transmutation → Force
